blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila Archbishop Jose Cardinal Advincula has ordered all parishes and communities in the Archdiocese of Manila to pray for rain amid the threat of a strong El Niño that could bring prolonged drought and water scarcity. In a circular released on Thursday, Advincula directed churches to include the Oratio Imperata ad Petendam Pluviam (Prayer for Rain) in daily Eucharistic celebrations, following the Post-Communion Prayer, starting Sunday, Nov. 8, until further notice. “As we implore the Lord to grant us the gift of rain, let us be reminded of the power of united prayer,” Advincula said.
